title: Micah Parsons: Don't worry about when I'm back, worry about how I'll be

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Micah Parsons: Don't worry about when I'm back, worry about how I'll be
sources.description: It remains unclear when Packers defensive end Micah Parsons will be back on the field, but he doesn't think anyone should be focused on the calendar when thinking about his return from last year's torn ACL.
